analysis.title: Apple is doing something it has never done before
key_insights: AAPL has been largely immune to the recent market selloff, diverging from the SOX and from the rest of the Magnificent 7.
AAPL is trading near all-time highs and is closing in on NVDA as the world's most valuable company.
AAPL has emerged as the defensive play within tech, with a forward FCF yield of around 3.15%, above that of the NDX.
AAPL's rolling two-month correlation with the NDX has turned negative for the first time in history, which the note reads as a flight to safety within tech.

The note describes AAPL as a defensive winner and a possible unintended beneficiary of the AI trade, a thesis first outlined on September 23 in 'Apple Just Put Nvidia's Inference Trade To The Test'. AAPL has outperformed NVDA since, and the six-month divergence is larger.
AAPL implied volatility has risen as investors buy equity protection, but the stress in AAPL is modest compared with the jump in fear across the broader tech sector.
